asset.name: SchemaFormRenderer
asset.description: Compiles data, layout, validation, dependency, permission, and action schemas into the generated-form runtime and a cached field-dependency graph.

requires.reason: Output targets the shared form runtime; the compiler must not become a second form implementation.

rationale: Compiles once and caches by schema identity and version. Re-normalizing a schema on every render is the difference between a generated form that feels native and one that feels generated.
